question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT d.DATE_DAY, d.DAY_NAME, COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS DELIVERED_ORDERS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE d
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
   AND o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
  WHERE d.DATE_DAY >= '2025-01-01' AND d.DATE_DAY < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.DATE_DAY, d.DAY_NAME
)
SELECT DAY_NAME AS WEEKDAY,
       AVG(DELIVERED_ORDERS) AS AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE,
       COUNT(*) AS CALENDAR_DATES
FROM daily
GROUP BY DAY_NAME
ORDER BY AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE DESC

action.answer: Across all calendar dates in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, the average Delivered orders per date by weekday were: Saturday 14486.211538 (52 dates); Sunday 13119.134615 (52); Friday 12228.980769 (52); Thursday 9473.653846 (52); Monday 9094.365385 (52); Tuesday 9082.788462 (52); Wednesday 9053.773585 (53). Saturday had the highest average, at 14486.211538 Delivered orders per calendar date.
